motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The only easing: block landing, button lift, arrow nudge.

motion.name: land
motion.value: transform 0.55s settle, opacity 0.3s ease-out, stagger 90ms per item, from translateY(-34px)
motion.purpose: Blocks land once when their group enters view (IntersectionObserver, rootMargin 0 0 -12%).

motion.name: press
motion.value: transform 0.18s settle, box-shadow 0.18s ease-out, border-bottom-width 0.12s ease-out

motion.name: blink
motion.value: 5.4s infinite, scaleY 1 -> 0.08 at 94-96%, second eye delayed 60ms
motion.purpose: Open eyes on an active agent block.

motion.name: pointer-follow
motion.value: rest rotateX(-18deg) rotateY(28deg); range +/-14deg pitch, +/-24deg yaw; lerp 0.12 per frame
motion.purpose: Hero cube turns toward the pointer.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no reveal, no blink, no bob, no follow, scroll-behavior auto

motion.name: quick
motion.purpose: Console control transitions (transform, box-shadow, background, border) on the settle ease.

motion.name: cube-nod
motion.value: rotateX −3deg over 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; eyes look down 6%, blink 3.2s

motion.name: cube-drift
motion.value: −4deg pitch, +6deg yaw, −6% rise over 6s ease-in-out infinite; half-lid eyes, no blink

motion.name: cube-zz
motion.value: three z’s drift 25% right, 45% up over 3.9s ease-out, 1.3s apart

motion.name: console-reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transition durations 0.001ms; cube body, eyes, z’s and glow animation none; first z visible; pointer follow never attached

components.css: .ds-cube { --size: 120px; position: relative; width: var(--size); height: var(--size); margin: 20px auto 50px; perspective: calc(var(--size) * 9); } .ds-cube__body { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-style: preserve-3d; transform: rotateX(-18deg) rotateY(28deg); } .ds-face { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; background: linear-gradient(165deg, color-mix(in oklab, #f26a1b, white 7%), #f26a1b 45%, color-mix(in oklab, #f26a1b, black 7%)); backface-visibility: hidden; } .ds-face--front { transform: translateZ(calc(var(--size) / 2)); } .ds-face--back { transform: rotateY(180deg) translateZ(calc(var(--size) / 2)); } .ds-face--right, .ds-face--left { background: #c9530f; } .ds-face--right { transform: rotateY(90deg) translateZ(calc(var(--size) / 2)); } .ds-face--left { transform: rotateY(-90deg) translateZ(calc(var(--size) / 2)); } .ds-face--top { background: #ff8a3d; transform: rotateX(90deg) translateZ(calc(var(--size) / 2)); } .ds-face--bottom { background: #a6420a; transform: rotateX(-90deg) translateZ(calc(var(--size) / 2)); } .ds-eyes { display: flex; gap: calc(var(--size) * 0.1); width: calc(var(--size) * 0.56); transform: translateY(calc(var(--size) * 0.02)); } .ds-eye { width: calc(var(--size) * 0.23); height: calc(var(--size) * 0.23); color: #2b2420; transform-origin: 50% 55%; animation: ds-blink 5.4s infinite; } .ds-eye svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0%, 91%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); } 94%, 96% { transform: scaleY(0.08); } } .ds-contact { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: calc(var(--size) * -0.22); width: calc(var(--size) * 1.35); height: calc(var(--size) * 0.28); translate: -50% 0; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgb(43 36 32 / 0.28), rgb(43 36 32 / 0)); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-eye { animation: none; } }

components.css: .ds-cbtn{--face:var(--raised,#fff);--edge:var(--paper-deep,#e8e1d4);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;padding:7px 14px 9px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--face);color:var(--ink,#2b2420);font:600 0.8125rem/1.2 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--edge),0 1px 0 rgb(43 36 32/0.08);transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-cbtn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--edge),0 6px 14px -6px rgb(43 36 32/0.35)}.ds-cbtn:active{transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--edge)}.ds-cbtn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--orange,#f26a1b);outline-offset:2px}.ds-cbtn--danger{--face:var(--danger-wash,#fbe4df);--edge:var(--danger,#c23b22);color:var(--danger,#c23b22)}.ds-cbtn--ghost{--edge:transparent;background:transparent;box-shadow:none}.ds-cbtn--ghost:hover{background:rgb(43 36 32/0.06);box-shadow:none;transform:none}

components.name: Console Field
components.description: Raised field with a Line Strong border; focus turns the border orange with a 3px orange ring.
components.css: .ds-cfield{display:grid;gap:6px;font:600 0.8125rem/1.5 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink-soft,#5e5249)}.ds-cfield>span:first-child{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.ds-cfield__hint{font-weight:400;font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--ink-faint,#776a5f)}.ds-cinput{width:100%;min-height:38px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,rgb(43 36 32/0.22));border-radius:8px;background:var(--raised,#fff);color:var(--ink,#2b2420);font:400 0.9375rem/1.5 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;transition:border-color 160ms,box-shadow 160ms}.ds-cinput::placeholder{color:var(--ink-faint,#776a5f)}.ds-cinput:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--orange,#f26a1b);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(242 106 27/0.25)}

components.name: Console Chips
components.description: Small 6px chips: inset default, paint/sage/wood with a 2px deep edge, danger on wash.
components.html: Room · launch Running Sleeping Planned Failed
components.css: .ds-cchip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:2px 9px 3px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--inset,#f3ebdf);color:var(--ink-soft,#5e5249);font:700 0.75rem/1.4 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}.ds-cchip--paint{background:var(--orange,#f26a1b);color:#2b2420;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--orange-deep,#c9530f)}.ds-cchip--sage{background:var(--sage,#9bb7a4);color:#2b2420;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--sage-deep,#6f8f7a)}.ds-cchip--wood{background:var(--wood,#e9cfa5);color:#2b2420;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--wood-deep,#d4b380)}.ds-cchip--danger{background:var(--danger-wash,#fbe4df);color:var(--danger,#c23b22)}

components.name: Sidebar Rows
components.description: Sidebar rows on the deepest plane: hover wash, flat orange current fill with no edge, 700 label when unread, orange badge.
components.html: ScribeCourier3Keeper
components.css: .ds-csb{display:grid;gap:2px;padding:8px;background:var(--sidebar,#efe3d1);width:260px;font-family:Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-csb__head{appearance:none;border:0;background:none;text-align:left;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;font:700 0.8125rem/1.5 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink-soft,#5e5249);cursor:pointer}.ds-crow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:34px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--ink,#2b2420);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.9375rem;transition:background 160ms}.ds-crow:hover{background:rgb(43 36 32/0.06)}.ds-crow[aria-current=page]{background:var(--orange,#f26a1b);color:#2b2420}.ds-crow:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--orange,#f26a1b);outline-offset:2px}.ds-crow__cube{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(165deg,#ff8a3d,#f26a1b 45%,#c9530f);flex:none}.ds-crow__label{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-crow--unread .ds-crow__label{font-weight:700}.ds-cbadge{min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--orange,#f26a1b);color:#2b2420;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--orange-deep,#c9530f)}

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Inset tray; the current tab is a raised face with a 1px shadow.
components.css: .ds-ctabs{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:3px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--inset,#f3ebdf);width:max-content}.ds-ctabs>button{appearance:none;border:0;background:none;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:6px;font:600 0.8125rem/1.5 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink-soft,#5e5249);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.ds-ctabs>button:hover{color:var(--ink,#2b2420)}.ds-ctabs>button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--orange,#f26a1b);outline-offset:2px}.ds-ctabs>[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--raised,#fff);color:var(--ink,#2b2420);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(43 36 32/0.15)}

components.css: .ds-cwork{border:1px solid var(--line,rgb(43 36 32/0.12));border-radius:8px;background:var(--inset,#f3ebdf);max-width:78ch;overflow:hidden;font-family:Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-cwork__summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;font-size:0.8125rem}.ds-cwork__summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-cwork__icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--raised,#fff);color:var(--ink-soft,#5e5249);flex:none}.ds-cwork__title{font-weight:700;text-transform:capitalize}.ds-cwork__cmd{flex:1;min-width:0;font:0.75rem ui-monospace,SF Mono,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;color:var(--ink-soft,#5e5249);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-cwork__ok{color:var(--success,#6f8f7a);display:flex}.ds-cwork__body{padding:0 10px 10px}.ds-cwork__pre{margin:0;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--code-bg,#f3ebdf);border:1px solid var(--line,rgb(43 36 32/0.12));font:0.75rem/1.5 ui-monospace,SF Mono,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;white-space:pre-wrap}

components.name: Thread Line

components.css: .ds-cthread{appearance:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:4px 10px 4px 6px;border:1px solid var(--line,rgb(43 36 32/0.12));border-radius:8px;background:var(--raised,#fff);color:var(--ink,#2b2420);font:600 0.8125rem/1.5 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 160ms}.ds-cthread:hover{border-color:var(--orange,#f26a1b)}.ds-cthread:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--orange,#f26a1b);outline-offset:2px}.ds-cthread__faces{display:flex}.ds-cthread__faces i{width:20px;height:20px;margin-right:-6px;border-radius:6px;border:2px solid var(--raised,#fff);background:var(--sage-deep,#6f8f7a);color:#fffdf9;font:800 0.75rem/16px Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;font-style:normal;display:grid;place-items:center}

components.css: .ds-ccomp{border:1px solid var(--line-strong,rgb(43 36 32/0.22));border-radius:10px;background:var(--raised,#fff);font-family:Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;transition:border-color 160ms,box-shadow 160ms}.ds-ccomp:focus-within{border-color:var(--orange,#f26a1b);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(242 106 27/0.2)}.ds-ccomp__input{display:block;width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#2b2420);font:400 0.9375rem/1.5 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;padding:12px 14px 6px;resize:none;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box}.ds-ccomp__input:focus{outline:none}.ds-ccomp__input::placeholder{color:var(--ink-faint,#776a5f)}.ds-ccomp__bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:4px 8px 8px 10px}.ds-ccomp__note{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:0.8125rem;color:var(--ink-faint,#776a5f);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-ccomp__send{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:30px;padding:4px 10px 6px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--orange,#f26a1b);color:#2b2420;font:600 0.75rem/1.2 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--orange-deep,#c9530f),0 1px 0 rgb(43 36 32/0.08)}.ds-ccomp__send:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--orange-deep,#c9530f),0 6px 14px -6px rgb(43 36 32/0.35)}.ds-ccomp__send:active{transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--orange-deep,#c9530f)}

narrative.overview:
Cubebot is a warm desk with painted wooden blocks on it. The ground is pale paper-warm desk, a birch shelf runs through the scenes, and the only saturated color is the orange paint on the blocks. One painted block has eyes: that block is the agent, and every other block is a part of its body or a neighbor in its cluster. The page explains the product by stacking blocks rather than by framing screenshots or laying out feature cards. Sections sit directly on the desk; depth comes from a block's own darker bottom edge and a soft contact shadow underneath it, never from floating panels.

The type is one face, Rubik, used heavy and tight for headings (stamped letterforms) and regular for reading. Motion is physical and small: a block lands once with a single ease-out settle, the hero cube bobs, blinks, and turns toward the pointer. Nothing glows, nothing slides in from the side, nothing is dark.

The world carries one content rule from the product: honesty about state. Implemented, in progress, and planned are always visually distinct (painted, half-painted, raw wood), so a reader can tell what runs today without reading the copy.
keyCharacteristics: Light warm desk ground; one saturated paint color (orange); sage as the single cool relief
Blocks, not cards: a painted face with a darker bottom edge and a blurred contact shadow
Rubik throughout; Black/ExtraBold headings with negative tracking, Regular body
Material tones double as status: orange = painted/active, sage = sleeping, paper = infrastructure, wood = raw/planned
Motion is one settle, one blink, one bob; reduced motion freezes every pose

rules.name: The One Paint Rule
rules.body: Orange is paint, not decoration. It appears on blocks, block buttons, chips, underlines, and the focus ring, and nowhere else: no orange text headings, no orange backgrounds, no gradient text.

rules.name: The Tone Is Status Rule
rules.body: A block's material tells its state. Orange is painted/implemented/active, half-painted (orange end on raw wood) is in progress, raw wood is planned, paper is infrastructure, sage is sleeping. Never use these tones decoratively against their meaning.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: No black or cool shadows. Every shadow and divider is rgb(43 36 32 / a).

rules.name: The Heavy Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings are 800 or 900 with negative tracking and line-height <= 1.05. There is no light or thin display setting.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading. Status and date stamps live below the actions, not as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Blurred Contact Rule
rules.body: Every external shadow is blurred and warm. Hard, zero-blur offset shadows do not exist here; the one zero-blur inset (the half-painted chip's orange end) is paint, not shadow.

rules.name: The Bottom Edge Rule
rules.body: A pressable or status-bearing block always shows its darker bottom edge in the same tone family (*-deep). Pressing shrinks the edge from 4px to 2px and moves the block down 2px.

rules.name: The Sidebar Is the Deepest Plane Rule
rules.body: In both themes the planes order sidebar → ground → surface → raised, darkest to lightest, and the conversation sits on the lightest large plane. The dark theme is this order in warm near-black: `#120e0b` → `#201a16` → `#26201b` → `#2b2420`. No plane may be lighter than the one that floats on it.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange is the only accent: selection, primary action, unread, focus. Status dots and chips use the world's paints (sage, wood, plum, danger) and are never used to point.

rules.name: The Desk at Night Rule
rules.body: Dark mode (`prefers-color-scheme: dark` unless `data-theme="light"`, or `data-theme="dark"`) swaps only the planes, inks, lines, washes and status tints. Orange, the paints and the cube's lighting are unchanged; the shadow base becomes black (`--shadow: 0 0 0`) and button edges become `rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35)`.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Console type never scales with the viewport. Pick one of the seven steps.

rules.name: The Bold Name Rule
rules.body: An agent is found by its face and its bold name: author names and the wordmark are 800; an unread row goes to 700. Nothing else in a row is bold.

rules.name: The Inset Edge Rule
rules.body: The block's bottom edge is drawn as an inset shadow (3px rest, 1px pressed) so a control's box never grows. Buttons lift 1px on hover and sink 1px when pressed, over 160ms on the settle ease.

rules.name: The Flat Selection Rule
rules.body: The selected sidebar row and the selected palette hit are flat orange fills with no edge and no shadow: selection is paint on the desk, not a block to press.

dos: Do build every interactive or status element as a block: tone face, *-deep bottom edge, 8–10px radius, ink text.
Do show state through material: orange painted, half-painted, raw wood, paper, sage. Implemented, in progress, and planned must be distinguishable without reading.
Do keep orange the only saturated color and sage the only cool one.
Do rest blocks on wood shelves or trays with a blurred contact shadow when they sit on the desk.
Do use one settle easing and land things once; give reduced-motion users a static pose.
Do set headings in Rubik 800–900 with negative tracking and cap reading copy at 62ch.
Console: Do place the conversation on Surface, management on Ground, chrome on Sidebar, and controls on Raised; depth is the plane, not a shadow.
Console: Do keep orange to selection, the one primary action per surface, unread marks and focus; use the sidebar's flat orange fill for "you are here" and the inset-edge block for "press me".
Console: Do set every size from the seven-step rem scale and the 6 / 8 / 10 / 14px radii.
Console: Do show an agent as its cube and bold name wherever it appears (sidebar, head, messages, thread faces) and let the cube's mood come from activity.
Console: Do use Float for anything that leaves the desk (menus, dialogs, the preview) and warm blurred shadows only; in the dark theme the base is black at the same alphas.
Console: Do honour reduced motion: static cube, first z shown, no pointer follow, no pulses.
donts: Don't use cards or bordered panels as page structure; sections are flat regions of the desk, alternating Desk and Desk Deep.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use gradient text, orange headings, or a dark hero.
Don't use zero-blur offset shadows or black/cool shadows; shadows are warm ink, blurred.
Don't add a second typeface, light display weights, or uppercase tracking.
Don't give eyes to a block that is not an agent, or open eyes to one that is sleeping.
Console: Don't bring the site's scenery into the console: no shelves, mugs, plants, slabs or painted-block scenes; the cube is the only illustration.
Console: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading; the section heads in the sidebar and panel are headings, not eyebrows.
Console: Don't add a second accent: status dots and chips are the world's paints and never point; a non-orange filled control is a mistake.
Console: Don't use fluid type, a heading above 1.5rem, uppercase tracking or a second typeface; mono is for commands and output only.
Console: Don't give the selected sidebar row an edge or a shadow, or give a block button a zero-blur drop.
Console: Don't make any plane lighter than the plane that floats on it; the sidebar is always the deepest.
